rows.classical: Goetia: King ruling in the East; appears as cat, toad, man or all three at once. No offering instruction in the classical texts.
rows.notes: Frankincense has 2+ sources (Connolly, BALG forum). Yellow, frankincense and fern come from Connolly. Wine/beer is 2 forum users. Water, oatmeal, dates and rutilated quartz come only from scarletarosa (single-source UPG). Several forum users stress time and attention over material gifts. Blood is mentioned by forum users but left out here.

rows.classical: Goetia/Pseudomonarchia: Duke under the power of the East; old man riding a crocodile with a goshawk. No offering instruction.
rows.timing: Modern decan (Connolly): Mar 31-Apr 10. Other date lists run Mar 30-Apr 8.
rows.notes: Correspondences come from Connolly's Duke/Venus set (green, sandalwood, copper) plus carnation. Myrrh is an alternate incense on the same page. No practitioner food or drink offerings found. Low information.

rows.offerings:
Leek (plant)
Earl Grey tea
White wine
Books
Deck of cards
Blue sapphire/beads
rows.classical: Goetia: a Mighty Prince 'of the same nature as Agares', and 'of a Good Nature'. Declares things past and to come, and discovers all things hid or lost. No appearance or offering instruction is given.
rows.notes: Blue, cedar, leek and Jupiter come from Connolly. The teas, wine and cards are single-source (scarletarosa). Cedar appears in 2 sources. Some sites suggest divination tools and crystals as generic tributes.

rows.classical: Goetia: Marquis appearing as a little horse or ass; gives account of dead souls that died in sin. No offering instruction.
rows.notes: Purple, jasmine and juniper come from Connolly's Marquis/Moon set. A bed of lavender ringed with juniper plus a stone sigil comes from 1 practitioner comment. Low-quality web guides add bones and ancestor-type offerings (not included). Low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: President, appears as a great lion; causes and cures diseases and teaches mechanical arts. No offering instruction.
rows.notes: Orange, storax and chicory come from Connolly's President/Mercury set. The cinnamon roll is from 1 BALG forum user. Whiskey, peppers, oranges and carnelian come only from scarletarosa, which also lists chicory burnt on charcoal, so chicory has 2 sources.

rows.classical: Goetia: a mighty Duke; a lion with an ass's head, bellowing. A good familiar, but tempts those he is a familiar of to steal. No offering instruction.
rows.notes: Green, sandalwood and dandelion come from Connolly. Wine and tobacco come from low-authority web guides (single-source). Little practitioner data.

rows.classical: Goetia: a Marquis great in power and most stern; a wolf with a serpent's tail vomiting flames of fire. Procures feuds and reconciles controversies between friends. No offering instruction.
rows.notes: Only Connolly's Marquis/Moon correspondences were found. Nightshade is toxic, so treat it as a symbolic plant, not a food. No reliable practitioner offering list found. Low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: a Great Duke who 'appeareth when the Sun is in Sagittary, with four noble Kings and their companies of great troops'. Gives understanding of the singing of birds and breaks open hidden treasures laid by the enchantments of magicians. No offering instruction.
rows.timing: Goetia: 'appeareth when the Sun is in Sagittary'. Modern decan (Connolly): Jun 1-10.
rows.notes: Only Connolly's Duke set plus ground ivy was found. No specific practitioner offerings. Low information.

Feast fit for a king
rows.classical: Goetia: 'if thou callest this Spirit Paimon alone, thou must make him some offering; and there will attend him two Kings called LABAL and ABALIM', with other spirits of the Order of Potentates and 25 Legions. He is 'to be observed towards the West'. Pseudomonarchia (Weyer): if cited alone 'by an offering or sacrifice', two kings, Bebal and Abalam, follow him; it also speaks of sacrifices and libations, and has the exorcist look north (Scot's English says northwest).
rows.timing: Modern decan (Connolly): Jun 11-20. Alternate quinance: Apr 30-May 4 (Runyon).
rows.notes: This is the only spirit in 1-36 with an explicit classical offering requirement. Frankincense and gold have 3+ sources. Music, poetry and honey show up across several modern sources. Blue/black colours come from 1 commenter and Black Witch Coven. Oud comes only from scarletarosa. BALG users note that offerings are optional and often given after results.

rows.classical: Goetia: Great President who 'appeareth in Sagittary, and that is his shape when the Sun is there'; teaches moral and natural philosophy, logic and the virtues of all herbs and plants, heals all distempers in man and gives good familiars.
rows.timing: His Goetia entry sets no calling time (the Goetia's general rule for Presidents applies); it says only: 'He appeareth in Sagittary, and that is his shape when the Sun is there.' Modern decan (Connolly): Jun 21-Jul 1.
rows.notes: Orange, storax and aloe come from Connolly. 'No alcohol; herbal tea, juice or kombucha instead' is a single channelled source (Bane Belladonna, Medium).
Only Connolly's Duke/Venus set was found. The page lists aloe, the same plant as Buer. No practitioner offerings found. Low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: Prince with a leopard's head and gryphon wings; causes love and makes people show themselves naked. No offering instruction.
rows.notes: Blue, cedar and hyacinth come from Connolly's Prince/Jupiter set. Roses, perfume and red/pink candles appear in several web guides. The wine and fruit list comes from scarletarosa (single-source), which says Sitri does not want sexual offerings.

rows.classical: Goetia: hold a hazel wand toward the South and East, draw a triangle outside the circle, wear a silver ring on the left middle finger held to the face, and receive him courteously and do homage as a great King. Pseudomonarchia adds a bowl of wine to his conjuration.
rows.notes: Wine has 2+ sources (Pseudomonarchia bowl of wine, BALG forum). The BALG forum stresses heartfelt personal art. Yellow, frankincense and dill come from Connolly. Courtesy and homage are a classical requirement.

rows.classical: Goetia: Marquis appearing as an archer clad in green; causes battles and makes arrow wounds putrefy.
rows.notes: Violet, jasmine and plantain come from Connolly, and 1 commenter offered plantain and jasmine (2 sources). Wine, arrowhead and laurel come from web ritual guides (single-source). Green echoes his classical appearance.

rows.classical: Goetia: Duke appearing as a goodly knight with lance, ensign and serpent; knows wars and causes the love of lords.
rows.notes: Thyme has 2 sources (Connolly plant, scarletarosa incense). Green and sandalwood come from Connolly. The beer, meat and war items come only from scarletarosa (listed under Abigor, treated as Eligos).

rows.classical: Goetia: Duke in red apparel and armour; causes women to love men.
rows.notes: Sandalwood and green have 2 sources (Connolly and a BALG user). Vodka and red candles come from 1 BALG user. Roses appear in generic love-spirit guides.

rows.classical: Goetia: President and Earl; first a viper, then a man with great teeth and horns; reconciles friends and foes.
rows.notes: Orange, storax and lily come from Connolly. Mint and wine come from a single web ritual guide. Low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: Duke; like a strong man with a serpent's tail, sitting upon a 'Pale-coloured [Horse?]' (Mathers brackets 'horse' as uncertain; Crowley's editorial note says the Quartos have 'ass'). Knows the virtues of herbs and precious stones and can transport men suddenly from one country to another.
rows.notes: Green, sandalwood and mistletoe come from Connolly. Herbs and travel tokens are single-source web suggestions. Low information.

rows.notes: Sandalwood has 2+ sources. Roses, wine and copper appear in several lower-authority web guides. Green and aster come from Connolly.

rows.classical: Goetia: King, a man with a lion's face on a bear holding a viper, preceded by trumpets; finds treasure.
rows.notes: Orchid is Connolly's plant, and a second site repeats it as the closing offering. Yellow and frankincense come from Connolly's King/Sun set. Gold and coins come from web guides.

rows.classical: Goetia: Earl and President, a great bull with a man's face; makes men knowing in astronomy and the liberal sciences; gives good, wise familiars who know the virtues of herbs and precious stones.
rows.notes: Only Connolly's Earl/Mars set plus elder was found. No practitioner offerings. Low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: Earl and Prince, an angel with a lion's head, a goose's foot and a hare's tail; knows past, present and future; makes men witty and bold.
rows.notes: Only Connolly's Prince/Jupiter set was found. No practitioner offerings. Very low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: Duke, a handsome man with three heads (serpent, man with two stars on his forehead, calf), riding a viper and carrying a firebrand; sets cities, castles and great places on fire.
rows.timing: Modern decan (Connolly): Nov 2-12. One web source says he is strongest at noon (single-source).
rows.notes: Green, sandalwood and lemon come from Connolly. Charred wood, red and myrrh are single-source fire-themed suggestions. Low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: Marquis appearing as a black crane with a hoarse voice; restores lost dignities and honours.
rows.notes: Only Connolly's Marquis/Moon set was found. No practitioner offerings. Low information.

rows.timing: Modern decan (Connolly): Nov 23-Dec 2. One BALG user describes bright overhead sunlight (UPG).
rows.notes: Rosemary and storax have 2+ sources (Connolly and BALG users). Yellow/gold altar cloth, gold rings and dog ornaments come from BALG forum threads (1-2 users).

rows.classical: Goetia: Duke, a dragon with three heads (dog, gryphon, man); speaks with a high, comely voice; changes the place of the dead and makes his spirits gather on your sepulchres; gives riches, wisdom, eloquence and true answers. Two seals, the second the better. No offering instruction.
rows.notes: One of the best documented. Sandalwood, citrus, copper and sweets each have 2+ sources (Connolly, DD comments, BALG, scarletarosa). Public praise and testimonials are a well-known modern practice (BALG, bunesuccess). Blood is mentioned by some users but not included.

rows.classical: Goetia: Marquis and Great Earl appearing as a monster; teaches rhetoric; gives good servants, knowledge of tongues, and favour with friends or foes.
rows.notes: Only Connolly's Marquis/Moon set plus cinnamon was found. No practitioner offerings. Low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: Duke, a soldier in red clothing on a red horse, with a crown of gold; use a ring in calling him, as with Beleth; also named Beale or Beal, and Bofry or Bolfry; turns all metals into gold; 'a Great Liar, and not to be trusted unto' (a footnote remarks this hardly agrees with his giving true answers). Pseudomonarchia: compelled at a certain hour by a ring of art magic.
rows.notes: Green and sandalwood come from Connolly. Red follows his classical appearance and is argued by commenters. Gold and metal items come from web guides. The black-chicken crossroads rite in some folk sources is left out.

rows.classical: Goetia: Duke, a hurtful angel riding an infernal beast like a dragon, with a viper in his right hand; do not let him come too near, lest his noisome breath do you damage; hold the magical ring near your face; wear his seal as a lamen or he will not appear or obey.
rows.notes: Sandalwood has 2 sources (Connolly and a BALG altar). Roses, cinnamon, lemon, perfume and a black candle come from 1 BALG user. scarletarosa says Astaroth dislikes being pampered with desserts (single-source).

rows.classical: Goetia: Marquis appearing as a great sea-monster; teaches rhetoric and gives a good name.
rows.notes: Only Connolly's Marquis/Moon set was found. No practitioner offerings. Low information.

rows.notes: Orange, storax and century plant come from Connolly. Herbs (sage, rosemary, bay) come from a single web guide. Commenters on the DD page asked for offerings and got no answer. Low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: King under Amaymon with three heads (bull, man, ram). Call him abroad (outdoors), standing on your feet, with your cap or headdress off. If you stay covered, Amaymon will deceive you.
rows.notes: Mint has 2 sources (Connolly plant, scarletarosa spearmint lemonade). Frankincense has 2+ sources. The drink and fruit list comes mainly from scarletarosa, echoed by Eclectic Witchcraft. Standing bareheaded is a classical etiquette note.

rows.classical: Goetia: President and Prince who appears in human shape when the Sun is in some of the southern signs, going before four great and mighty kings as if he were a guide to conduct them. Pseudomonarchia: necromancers offered him 'sacrifices and burnt offerings', a practice Weyer traces to Noah's son Cham, not Solomon.
rows.timing: Goetia: appears when the Sun is in some of the southern signs. Modern decan (Connolly): Feb 9-18.
rows.notes: There is a classical precedent for offerings (burnt offerings). Orange, storax and moss come from Connolly. Tobacco and frankincense come from single web guides.

rows.classical: Goetia: Earl appearing as a hart with a fiery tail. He never speaks truth unless compelled, or brought up within a triangle; there he takes the form of an angel and, when bidden, speaks with a hoarse voice. Raises lightning, thunder, blasts and great storms.
rows.notes: Only Connolly's Earl/Mars set plus cypress was found. Forum users mention only blood on the sigil (not included). Low information.

rows.classical: Goetia: Marquis, a wolf with gryphon wings and a serpent's tail vomiting fire; a strong fighter. Told Solomon he hoped to return to the Seventh Throne after 1200 years.
rows.notes: Violet, jasmine and pennyroyal come from Connolly (pennyroyal is toxic, so treat it as symbolic). Public praise comes from 1 commenter. scarletarosa lists silver and dark rubies but says Marchosias rarely accepts offerings (single-source).

rows.notes: Herbs and crystals have 2+ sources and match his classical office. Blue, cedar and flax come from Connolly. Owls, chamomile, ink and black candles come from scarletarosa, which says to avoid caffeine and sugar (single-source).

rows.classical: Goetia (1904): appears like the bird Phœnix, having the voice of a child; sings many sweet notes, which the exorcist must not heed, and by-and-by is bidden to put on human shape; a good and excellent poet; hopes to return to the Seventh Throne after 1,200 years more.
rows.timing: Night spirit; Libra 0-4° (~Sep 23-27, Runyon scheme via BWC). Connolly/Tikaboo alt: Mar 21-30.
rows.notes: modern/UPG. Poetry/creative offerings consistent across BALG forum + blogs (medium). Colours/incense disagree between sources (low).

rows.classical: Goetia: Earl; appears as a stock-dove with a hoarse voice; builds towers, furnishes munitions, sends men-of-war.
rows.notes: Little specific info. Chimes (single source, as a presence sign); myrrh single low-quality source. BALG 'Halphas offerings' thread gave no concrete items. Use rank fallback.

rows.notes: modern/UPG. Offering list mostly from one ritual write-up (BWC; low-medium). Storax/orange = President/Mercury correspondences (littledoomwitch). Classical warning about deceit is well attested.

rows.notes: modern/UPG. Order of Dark Arts list (single); sea items from Esoteric Witch; green/sandalwood = Duke/Venus correspondences (littledoomwitch). Mugwort held while chanting (single).

rows.classical: Goetia (1904): a stock-dove with a hoarse but subtle voice; takes away sight, hearing or understanding; steals money out of kings' houses and carries it again in 1,200 years; fetches horses or any other thing when commanded; must first be commanded into the Triangle or he will deceive and tell many lies; discovers hidden things not kept by wicked spirits; sometimes gives good familiars.
rows.notes: modern/UPG, low. Wine and apple each from single BALG posters; other items generic blog suggestions.

rows.classical: Goetia: appears as a monster, then at the exorcist's command in the shape of a man; teaches astrology, geometry and other arts and sciences, and the virtues of precious stones and woods; changes dead bodies and puts them in another place, and 'lighteth seeming Candles upon the Graves of the Dead'.
rows.notes: modern/UPG, low. Candle offering ties to the classical grave-candle image. Frankincense/myrrh in 2 sources.

rows.notes: modern/UPG, low. Wine (with a drop of blood) from one ritual write-up; incense list single-source.

rows.classical: Goetia: bull with gryphon wings; transmutes metals into gold, wine into water and water into wine.

rows.classical: Goetia: a Knight (the only spirit of that rank among the 72); a cruel old man with a long beard and a hoary head, riding a pale-coloured horse, with a sharp weapon in his hand; teaches philosophy, astrology, rhetoric, logic, cheiromancy and pyromancy, in all their parts and perfectly.
rows.notes: modern/UPG, low. Single ritual write-up; myrrh/black also match Knight/Saturn rank correspondences.

rows.classical: Goetia: three heads (bull, man, ram), serpent's tail, flaming eyes, rides a bear with a goshawk; gives true answers, makes men invisible and witty.

rows.notes: Little specific info (low); generic suggestions only.

Formerly of the Order of Angels.
rows.notes: modern/UPG, low. Storax is the President/Mercury correspondence.
